event: Nala stays still and listens as the woman above starts humming a slow, rocking tune.
prose: You stay still and listen. Above you the woman starts to hum, slow, rocking.

event: The tune has no words: the same few lines over and over, rising and falling like a cradle.
prose: There are no words in it. The same few lines come round again and again, up and down like a cradle tipping.

event: Nala hums along in her head, fitting Sa, vo, reth to it, one sound to a note.
prose: You hum along in your head and put the sounds to it, one to a note. Sa on the first. Vo on the second. Reth where the line dips at the end.

event: The three sounds sit in the tune; each time round, the shape comes easier to her.
prose: Each time the tune comes round, the three sounds are already waiting on their notes, and you reach them a little quicker than the time before.

event: Partway through a line the woman hums Sa-vo-reth herself, right where Nala put it.
prose: Partway through a line she hums it herself, softly, Sa-vo-reth, on the very notes where you put it.

event: A door opens and a second woman's voice comes in, quick; the humming stops mid-line.
